description: This file defines internal extension interfaces for stream consumers and producers in the Orleans streaming system. It declares methods for delivering items, handling stream completion or errors, and managing subscribers.

classes.name: IStreamConsumerExtension
classes.description: An internal interface extending IGrainExtension for stream consumers, providing methods for delivering items, completing streams, and error handling.

classes.name: IStreamProducerExtension
classes.description: An internal interface extending IGrainExtension for stream producers, providing methods to add and remove subscribers.

methods.name: DeliverImmutable
methods.description: Deliver an immutable item to the stream consumer with a handshake token.

methods.name: DeliverMutable
methods.description: Deliver a mutable item to the stream consumer with a handshake token.

methods.name: DeliverBatch
methods.description: Deliver a batch container to the stream consumer with a handshake token.

methods.name: CompleteStream
methods.description: Signal completion of the stream for a given subscription ID.

methods.name: ErrorInStream
methods.description: Report an error occurring in the stream for a specific subscription.

methods.name: GetSequenceToken
methods.description: Retrieve the current sequence token for a subscription.

methods.name: AddSubscriber
methods.description: Add a subscriber to a stream, with optional filter data.

methods.name: RemoveSubscriber
methods.description: Remove a subscriber from a stream.
